{{Quote|Men, the mission we're about to embark upon is considered highly dangerous by Imperial Command. Nevertheless, it's fallen on our shoulders to accomplish the impossible yet again!|Clayton Balrog briefs his platoon|<ref name="The Briefing of Spacetrooper Platoon 243-XT">{{WEGCite|story=The Briefing of Spacetrooper Platoon 243-XT|book=The Star Wars Sourcebook|reprint=1}}</ref>}}
'''Clayton Balrog''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Zero-G assault stormtrooper]] in command of [[Spacetrooper Platoon 243-XT]].

==Biography==
Clayton Balrog served in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]] as a [[Zero-G assault stormtrooper]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], holding the rank of [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]]. Balrog commanded [[Spacetrooper Platoon 243-XT]], which was based off a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]]. At some point, Balrog briefed the [[Platoon/Legends|platoon]] on a mission to capture the ''[[GrimDeath I]]'', a converted [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] crewed by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and suspected to be in league with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The ''GrimDeath I'' had conducted a series of raids throughout the [[Woldona system/Legends|Woldona system]] before heading to [[Galpos II/Legends|Galpos II]]. Originally, the plan had been to stand off and track the ''GrimDeath I'' while waiting for support from the [[Avenger/Legends|''Avenger'']] and ''[[Terminator/Legends|Terminator]]'' but [[Imperial High Command/Legends|Imperial High Command]] decided that they could not allow the pirates the opportunity to escape.<ref name="Briefing" />

Balrog outlined the new plan to the platoon; their Star Destroyer was to create a diversion while the platoon's [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] coasted in under cover of the ''GrimDeath I''{{'s}} engine noise. The objective was to capture the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] along with some command personnel for interrogation, which would be achieved by disabling the engines and then breaching the ship in two different positions; [[Strike Force One]] through the lower hull, and [[Strike Force Two]] through the bridge.<ref name="Briefing" />
